Appearance:

Ms. Vineeta Sharma - Panel Lawyer for respondent/State.

Order 
This is fifth application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure 1973 for grant of bail filed on behalf of the applicant who has been arrested relating to FIR/Crime No.180/2023 dated 13.03.2023 registered at Police Station Lordganj, District Jabalpur, for the offence punishable under Sections 294, 384, 376(2)N, 506, 376 and 326 of IPC.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in custody since 14.03.2023 and the trial will take considerable time to conclude.
He further submits that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
The applicant is a permanent resident of district and is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by all the conditions to be imposed by the Court.
Upon these grounds, it is prayed that the applicant be released on bail.
Learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
This fifth bail application has been argued on the ground of delay in trial and also on the ground that there was a delay in lodging the FIR.

It needs to be mentioned here that four successive bail applications of applicant were dismissed under M.Cr.C. Nos.19512/2023,
26848/2023, 50245/2023 and 5868/2024 and they all were decided on merits.
Therefore, the contention of delay in trial, age of prosecutrix, her consent in sexual activity have already been dealt with earlier.

New ground is the delay in trial and the documents filed by the applicant reveal that only one Abhaykumar Kosta vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89456839/
1 witness has been examined so far before the trial Court.

sentences.text: Keeping
in view
the allegations made against the applicant and slow progress of the trial
, it is directed that the trial Court shall endeavour to expedite the trial and close it within six months.

In case the trial is not concluded within that period, the applicant shall be at liberty to file afresh application for bail subject to the condition that this order is immediately placed before the trial Court to take note of it.
Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands dismissed.
